name: libkcddb
description: The libkcddb package contains a library used to retrieve audio CD meta data from the internet.

user:
cmake -B build -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$KF6_PREFIX \
      -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release         \
      -D BUILD_TESTING=OFF                \
      -D QT_MAJOR_VERSION=6               \
      -W no-dev .
